Name: American Kaiju
Description: Todd Ziller is a corporal in the United States army. When he was in college, he was in a philosophy class when his atheist professor dared God to smite him within 15 minutes. Just as the time limit ran out, Todd stood up and punched his professor in the face. This sense of character is what got the attention of Gen. Robert L. Maverick. Maverick was in charge of Project: Troubleshooter, an attempt at recreating Dr. Erskine ’s super soldier serum. The scientists involved used a number of transformative sciences including, gamma radiation, mutant growth hormone, pym particles, and Dr. Connors ’ lizard serum.
